A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (12 November 2022). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-boshek-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[BoShek (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same game text. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with sharper art and frame and the text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of “E”.

The whole previous image and the whole of this image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
